scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n server,extension -c auto "npm run dev -w @lensmap/server" "npm run dev -w @lensmap/chrome-extension"
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run extension:permissions:check
scripts.e2e:extension:live: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @lensmap/server && npm run build -w @lensmap/chrome-extension && node scripts/run-extension-e2e.mjs e2e/chrome-extension-live.mjs
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @lensmap/shared && npm run build -w @lensmap/visualization
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @lensmap/server && npm run build -w @lensmap/chrome-extension && npm run build -w @lensmap/landing-page
scripts.e2e:extension:real: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @lensmap/server && npm run build -w @lensmap/chrome-extension && node scripts/run-extension-e2e.mjs e2e/chrome-extension-real-pdf-smoke.mjs
scripts.e2e:extension:native-startup: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @lensmap/server && npm run build -w @lensmap/chrome-extension && node scripts/native-host-manager.mjs install && node scripts/run-extension-e2e.mjs e2e/chrome-extension-native-startup.mjs
scripts.native-host:install: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @lensmap/server && npm run build -w @lensmap/chrome-extension && node scripts/native-host-manager.mjs install
scripts.lp:build: npm run lp:assets && npm run build -w @lensmap/landing-page
scripts.lp:deploy:preview: npm run lp:build && wrangler pages deploy apps/landing-page/dist --project-name=lensmap --branch=preview
scripts.lp:deploy:production: npm run lp:check && npm run lp:acceptance && wrangler pages deploy apps/landing-page/dist --project-name=lensmap --branch=main
